actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The package's model is the MJCF file iiwa7_mjcf/iiwa7_tuned.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="iiwa7_tuned">'
The model declares angle=radian with autolimits=true, so its joint and control ranges are radians
The model uses the implicitfast integrator with a timestep of 0.002 s

The model header describes its tuning as a general actuator with gaintype=fixed, biastype=affine, gainprm=2000 and biasprm '0 -2000 -200' (PD kp=2000 kd=200), per-joint forcerange, armature 0.1 and seven contact excludes
The iiwa default class gives every arm joint the axis 0 0 1, damping 0.5 and armature 0.1, and the default general actuators gaintype=fixed, biastype=affine, gainprm=2000 and biasprm '0 -2000 -200'
The joint1 default class sets the joint range -2.96706 to 2.96706 rad and the matching ctrlrange, with a forcerange of -176 to 176
The joint2 default class sets the joint range -2.09440 to 2.09440 rad and the matching ctrlrange, with a forcerange of -176 to 176
The joint3_mid default class sets the joint range -2.96706 to 2.96706 rad and the matching ctrlrange, with a forcerange of -110 to 110
The joint4_mid default class sets the joint range -2.09440 to 2.09440 rad and ref 1.5708, with the matching ctrlrange and a forcerange of -110 to 110
The joint5_mid default class sets the joint range -2.96706 to 2.96706 rad and the matching ctrlrange, with a forcerange of -110 to 110
The joint6_distal default class sets the joint range -2.09440 to 2.09440 rad and ref -1.5708, with the matching ctrlrange and a forcerange of -40 to 40
The joint7_distal default class sets the joint range -3.05433 to 3.05433 rad and the matching ctrlrange, with a forcerange of -40 to 40
The model has seven joints, iiwa_joint_1 to iiwa_joint_7, on the link bodies iiwa_link_1 to iiwa_link_7
The model has seven general actuators, actuator1 to actuator7, on iiwa_joint_1 to iiwa_joint_7, each naming the matching joint default class so it takes that class's ctrlrange
The arm's tool point is the site attachment_site at 0 0 0.05 on iiwa_link_7, 5 cm along its local +Z
The model excludes seven non-adjacent body pairs from collision, from iiwa_link_0/iiwa_link_1 to iiwa_link_5/iiwa_link_7
The model has one home keyframe whose qpos and ctrl are all zeros
iiwa7_tuned.xml is the MuJoCo (MJCF) model of the KUKA LBR iiwa 7 R800, converted from the ROS iiwa_stack URDF and tuned to mujoco_menagerie/kuka_iiwa_14 engineering conventions
The home keyframe matches the real robot's ready pose of J4 = -90 degrees and J6 = +90 degrees, with the other joints at 0 degrees
Because iiwa7.xml sets ref=+1.5708 on J4 and ref=-1.5708 on J6, qpos zero is that home pose; the physical angle is qpos - ref
The pose API takes a 7-vector [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] in the base frame, in metres and with the quaternion in xyzw order
The controller drives only the seven arm joints: ARM_NV = 7 and ARM_NU = 7, so any gripper channel beyond them stays independent
The tuned model's forcerange is -176 to 176 N m for J1/J2, -110 to 110 N m for J3 to J5 and -40 to 40 N m for J6/J7, from the iiwa7 datasheet
The clone also ships iiwa7_with_gripper.xml (the arm plus a Robotiq 2F-85 on the flange) and robotiq_2f85.xml (the standalone gripper)

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed input (cap.world.reset.v1 accepts a seed for the class contract and ignores it) and restores the model defaults, so a run repeats on the same engine but no seed selects a different state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the model file for the joint count, the actuator count and the per-actuator control ranges but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts, inertias, damping, armature, PD gains and forceranges are not MuJoCo's
no mesh or texture of the meshes directory is loaded and no contact, equality or tendon constraint is resolved by the stand-in; the seven contact excludes of the model are not applied
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering is offered and no physical iiwa7 robot is modelled; nothing was validated against KUKA hardware
only the card's first model is served: the composite iiwa7_with_gripper.xml (eight actuators, the gripper on ctrl[7]) and the standalone robotiq_2f85.xml are not served by this package

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
